messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary anomaly detected for model redwood-v2-small in us-west2. error_rate +4.2% above threshold. samples failing tokenization. thread started.

amanda (oncall): on it, looking. pinging @sheraz @jason

deploy-bot: logs: `tokenizer: mismatch: expected vocab size 50257, got 50258` ; weightset checksum mismatch detected: expected sha256=abc123def456... got sha256=abc124def457...

sheraz: wow, that checksum diff suggests wrong weight bundle pushed to the canary. did the publish job tag wrong namespace? any deploy tags?

jason: Support flagged 3 customers seeing garbled completions and high latency. customer IDs: acme_inc, quickchat, noteapp

amanda (oncall): switching traffic to safe tier, enabling feature-flag kill-switch for redwood-v2-small canary now.

release-bot: Feature flag flipped: `ff:redwood.v2.small.canary.disable` -> true by amanda (oncall). Traffic routed to fallback model redwood-v1.8-small.

maria: opening incident bridge + notifying CS. I'll draft customer note.

sheraz: recommend rollback to artifact redwood-v2-small@sha=fff999 (previous good). starting rollback.

release-bot: Rollback job started: rolling back model group redwood-v2-small -> redwood-v2-small@fff999 across us-west2.

amanda (oncall): quick customer-impact snapshot: ~2.8% of total requests routed to canary during window. error spike ~4% of those users. No PII affected. Priority: high for customers with real-time features.

pagerduty: Incident escalated to SEV2, on-call escalation: amanda -> sheraz -> jason

jason: rollback finished on 70% of nodes, monitoring. doing quick smoke tests.

deploy-bot: smoke checks: tokenization OK, generation sanity checks passed on rolled hosts.

amanda (oncall): passing to post-incident: collect build artifacts, verify publish job logs, reconcile publish namespace mapping. tagging for follow-up: #followup-ops #postmortem

maria: CS note sent to affected customers: apology + temporary mitigation (traffic routed to stable model), ETA for full resolution: 2h. Will update channel with any customer replies.

sheraz: hypothesis: CI artifact promotion script accidentally used staging namespace when promoting release candidate. action items: add checksum verification to promotion and block if mismatch.

amanda (oncall): good plan. assigning owners: sheraz -> fix promotion script, jason -> add post-deploy tokenization smoke tests, maria -> customer comms update. will keep channel open for 1h for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
